title: Residual certificates for the Erdős–Straus conjecture: exact solvability criteria, almost-all certificate bounds, and computations to 10^11
description: Companion repository for the paper: the residual-method solver and verification pipelines, certificate datasets for all 128,671,219 hard primes below 10^11, the Lean 4/mathlib formalization of the elementary and finite-enumeration layers, the full theoretical development notes, and the Burgess–reciprocity ladder census archives.
